claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 76 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
The requested budget of INR 12,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Workshop.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
